public.title: Middle of the Linked List
public.description: values serializes a nonempty singly linked list from head to tail. Return the suffix beginning at its middle node. For even length, select the second of the two middle nodes. There are 1 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000. This JSON form returns node values and does not test pointer identity.
hints: The second middle has zero-based index floor(length / 2).
Return the full suffix rather than one value.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: The serialized middle index directly identifies the requested suffix. O(n) output copying time and space; linked-node variants can use slow and fast pointers.
